runtime.dependencies: Python standard library; existing native Rust allocator.

limits: 2026 inputs and earlier outcomes were known in development; this is a frozen retrospective challenge.
Threshold stratification uses exact 2022 labels only for partitioning; no natural-frequency or prospective sampling claim.
Known official zero-transfer baseline is an explicit model input.
Direction and district levels are categorical and must already be represented during fitting.
No rounding/clipping and no automatic production promotion; exact Rust remains authoritative.
